description: Live clipping campaigns that pay for clips of a named streamer or a game: rate per 1,000 views, cap per clip, budget left, the view floor, and where to join. A streamer match is a campaign whose brief links their channel or whose title names them. A game match is a campaign for that game. Answers 'who pays for clips of xQc', 'which campaigns pay for Kai Cenat', 'who pays for Fortnite clips', 'who pays for GTA clips'. A name with no live campaign comes back found false, with watch_streamer as the next step: heistclips then tells the user when a campaign for that streamer opens.

name.description: A streamer (Twitch or Kick name or link, or their name) or a game (Fortnite, GTA, Just Chatting)

name: campaigns_for_streamer
